mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, demand_id, version_id, judged_stage, effective_on, judge_reason, judged_by_user_id, judged_by_name, judged_at, revoked_at, revoked_by_user_id, revoked_by_name, revoke_reason
mapper.select: SELECT FROM demand_delivery_judgement WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId} AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_delivery_judgement WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand_delivery_judgement (workspace_id, demand_id, version_id, judged_stage, effective_on, judge_reason, judged_by_user_id, judged_by_name, judged_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{demandId}, #{versionId}, #{judgedStage}, #{effectiveOn}, #{judgeReason}, #{judgedByUserId}, #{judgedByName}, COALESCE(#{judgedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)))
mapper.update: UPDATE demand_delivery_judgement SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), revoked_by_user_id = #{revokedByUserId}, revoked_by_name = #{revokedByName}, revoke_reason = #{revokeReason} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM demand_delivery_judgement WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId}
